# ghost/baby-name

Baby Name (F-Droid): search a database of about 46000 first names by gender and a regular expression, then flip through the matches with gender and origin. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/baby-name
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/baby-name open_filter --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/baby-name set_filter --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/baby-name get_name --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/baby-name next_name --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/baby-name previous_name --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/baby-name list_names --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open_filter`: Open the baby name search form
- `set_filter`: Find female baby names starting with Ma and ending with a
- `get_name`: Which baby name is shown now?
- `next_name`: Show the next baby name
- `previous_name`: Show the previous baby name
- `list_names`: List five baby names from my search
